backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report referencing product dataset update for adding VIVO X300 PRO.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing all frontend source files and their roles.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles defining extensive OKLCH color variables and dark mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling page routing and category filter state.
frontend/src/components/CategoryCard.tsx: Card component showing a category with icon and navigate-to-products action.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Simple layout wrapper applying container spacing around children.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product display card showing image placeholder, name, category badge, description, and price.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with brand info, quick links, social icons, and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation, and active page handling.
frontend/src/data/products.ts: Local dataset of 13 products including the added VIVO X300 PRO smartphone.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook creating and refreshing authenticated or anonymous backend actors.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, exposing identity state and login/logout helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file reserved for future React Query hooks; currently exports nothing.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes with color palette settings.
frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: Provides simple validation helpers for required fields and email format checking.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders App.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, values, and product information using cards and layout components.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation, submission handling, and success alert within a layout.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the homepage hero, categories, and features, with navigation callbacks to other pages.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Lists products with search and category filters, rendering product cards based on filtered results.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, radius, shadows, animations, and enables typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project's state, tracking a feature request to add a VIVO X300 PRO product listing priced at 54999.
